purpose: Prepare spatial holdouts and propagate measurement uncertainty for the existing photon-companion and bulge-potential tests. This is not a completed orbital fit.
selection: gaia_quality_candidate from stellar-data-readiness; no additional kinematic outlier clipping

split.group: Gaia source-ID nested HEALPix level 4 sky cell; approximately 3.7 degree scale
split.rule: First 8 SHA256 bytes as big-endian integer modulo 10: 0-5 training, 6-7 validation, 8-9 test
split.disclosure: All-catalog exploratory moments were computed previously. These are model-development holdouts fixed before an orbital fit, not untouched blind observations. Sky-block splitting does not eliminate all shared selection/systematic errors.

uncertainty.distance: Asymmetric log-distance distribution matching StarHorse 16th, 50th and 84th quantiles; extrapolated tails. This is an approximation to the marginal posterior.
uncertainty.conditional_model: Gaussian Gaia RA*,Dec,proper-motion distribution conditioned on parallax = 1/distance + bias, mixed over the approximate StarHorse posterior. No additional parallax likelihood multiplication.
uncertainty.limitations: StarHorse reprocessed parallaxes/uncertainties and does not supply the full joint distance-astrometry posterior here. Constant bias values bracket a sensitivity case, not the Gaia per-source zero-point calibration. No spatially correlated calibration errors or survey selection correction is claimed.

photon_prediction.distance_unit: kpc divided by 1000 before using alpha
photon_prediction.status: Frozen earlier redshift fit; known exponential accumulation formula applied to proposed loss mechanism. Does not predict orbital velocities.

release_rule: Only training velocity moments may be summarized in this audit. Validation/test roles, coverage and measurement-error summaries may be checked. Reserve their orbital-fit scores for frozen models.
